algorithm: BAKU (ResNet-18 vision + MLP proprioception + transformer trunk + action-chunking head)
success_criterion: task completed within 120 s (120 s cutoff counted as failure), user study Sec. 4.5
headline_metric: teleoperation completion time and success rate vs. RUKA v1 (10-participant user study, Sec. 4.5)
headline_value: 51.3% reduction in mean completion time and 21.2% increase in overall success rate vs. RUKA v1
paper_code_mismatch: The parsed code/md is byte-for-byte the same ruka-hand/RUKA repo snapshot (same commit) as ruka_2025, so it does not include the v2 wrist/abduction hardware, magnetic-encoder support, or the new linear joint-to-motor controller described in this paper.
note_gaps: No reward/loss function is stated for the BAKU policy (architecture only); the linear joint-to-motor mapping assumption is noted by the authors as not formally verified; tactile e-flesh integration is left as future work.
